items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: He really made me in Europe

ctx.x:
Yeah, I think he went over there. And I don't know where Larry is now. Then he had quite a bit of distribution in Europe and Panacsee did a lot of things, you know, he thought I was just his man, you know, and everything. He really made me in Europe, you know, from the Hot Club in France, you know, and played my records all the time and everything. He just did everything, you know.

So then we started being asked to bring the band to Europe. We made about five trips, five or six trips with the Celebrity Club band…
Then I'd have to augment the band sometime because the minimum may be ten, may be eleven.
